description: Maintenance status: "what maintenance is due?" (overdue / this month / next quarter). Without arguments: the organization overview with counts (overdue, dueSoon, blocked), one card per maintenance plan in `plans` (name, assignee, matchedCount / overdueCount / dueSoonCount / openTicketCount), the due list for the next ~90 days sorted soonest first (each row names its plan, its item and, when a run ticket exists, its ticketId) and the blocked rows. A maintenance plan holds its checks together and is the level a person acts on, so the plan cards summarize what the due list details per item. Every plan has exactly ONE default assignee (a person or a team), so all its checks land on the same target by design. With itemId: that item's maintenance plans with last completed, next due and open ticket. Every date comes twice, epoch and ISO twin: `nextDueAtIso`, `openTicketDueAtIso` and the due list's `dueAtIso` are plain calendar days, `lastCompletedAtIso` is a UTC instant; the server does no timezone conversion. Read-only report: recording a check as done (walking its checklist) and creating or editing plans happen in the app only.

itemId.description: Item id: returns that item's plan rows instead of the org overview

blocked.description: Why the row cannot be scheduled

leadTimeDays.description: How early the run ticket opens

openTicketDueAtIso.description: The run ticket's due date as a plain calendar day, "YYYY-MM-DD"
